title: TEM Analysis Detail
description: Detail block for TEM hasPart items. Discriminates on ada:componentType, carries analysis-level required properties and an @id reference to a registered temTAPP definition, and per-dataset schema:additionalProperty entries constrained via $refs to the parameterValues registry plus a catch-all. Generated by tools/build_tapp.py.

items.title: Sample Preparation Details
items.description: Detailed description of section preparation conditions: FIB milling voltages and currents; final thinning conditions and target foil thickness; protective coating type and deposition method (e.g., e-beam vs. ion-beam Pt or C strip — e-beam deposition causes less surface damage); any post-FIB surface cleanup (e.g., low-energy Ar+ ion polishing in a Fischione NanoMill, final 0.5–2 kV Ga+ thinning); sample transfer and storage environment (ambient air, dry N₂ atmosphere, vacuum transfer holder, glovebox); plasma cleaning before loading. Includes session-specific observations and deviations from the procedure standard. Includes preparation artifacts noted (Ga implantation, amorphization, curtaining).

anyOf.title: EELS Plural Scattering Correction
anyOf.description: Method applied to correct for multiple inelastic scattering events (plural scattering) that broaden edge fine structure. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: Image Processing Methods Applied
anyOf.description: Image processing steps applied to TEM or STEM images during or after acquisition. Non-linear processing steps that could affect quantitative interpretation should be documented explicitly.

contains.description: Method applied to correct for multiple inelastic scattering events (plural scattering) that broaden edge fine structure. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: Sample Holder
anyOf.description: Type of specimen holder used.

anyOf.title: Spectroscopic Detector(s)
anyOf.description: Spectroscopic detectors present and used under this procedure. EDS and EELS parameter fields in Group 4 apply only when the corresponding detector is listed here.

anyOf.title: Analytical Sub-mode
anyOf.description: Sub-mode(s) of imaging or diffraction performed under this procedure. Multiple values apply when the procedure covers more than one sub-mode within a given analytical mode.

anyOf.title: EFTEM Energy Window
anyOf.description: Energy window(s) used for EFTEM elemental mapping: center energy, width, and acquisition method (three-window or jump-ratio). Record 'N/A' where EFTEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

anyOf.title: HAADF Collection Angles
anyOf.description: Inner and outer collection angles of the HAADF detector in milliradians (mrad). Inner angle can be derived from camera length and detector geometry.

anyOf.title: STEM Probe Diameter
anyOf.description: Nominal or measured diameter of the focused electron probe at the sample, reported in nm. Related to, but distinct from, Convergence Semi-Angle: the two quantities are connected via aberration coefficients, defocus, and probe current, which are not always published. Report whichever is known; if both are known, report both fields. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

anyOf.title: STEM Probe Current
anyOf.description: Probe current in picoamperes (pA) or nanoamperes (nA). Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

anyOf.title: Dwell Time per Pixel
anyOf.description: Time spent acquiring signal at each pixel during STEM scanning in milliseconds. For dose-sensitive materials, minimize dwell and compensate with frame averaging. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used. For 4D-STEM dwell time see '4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position'.

anyOf.title: STEM Scan Dimensions
anyOf.description: Number of pixels in the STEM scan frame (X × Y pixels). Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

anyOf.title: STEM Frame Averaging
anyOf.description: Number of frames averaged (with drift correction if applicable) to produce the final STEM image. Also governs STEM-EDS and STEM-EELS acquisition where those detectors are used.

anyOf.title: Camera Length
anyOf.description: Nominal camera length in millimeters used for diffraction pattern acquisition. Must be calibrated to convert pixel distances to d-spacings. Calibration to absolute d-spacings is required — see 'Diffraction Calibration Reference'.

anyOf.title: Selected-Area Aperture Size
anyOf.description: Diameter of the selected-area aperture used in SAED mode, defining the specimen region that contributes to the diffraction pattern.

anyOf.title: Precession Angle
anyOf.description: Precession semi-angle in degrees for precession electron diffraction (PED). Not applicable to SAED, CBED, or standard 4D-STEM. Record 'N/A' where Precession ED is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

anyOf.title: 4D-STEM Scan Grid and Area
anyOf.description: Number of probe positions in the 4D-STEM dataset (scan pixels × scan pixels) and the physical area covered. Probe step size is the physical area divided by scan pixel count. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

anyOf.title: 4D-STEM Dwell Time per Probe Position
anyOf.description: Time spent acquiring each diffraction pattern in the 4D-STEM dataset in milliseconds. Record 'N/A' where 4D-STEM is not listed in Analytical Sub-mode.

anyOf.title: Diffraction Camera Length Calibration Method
anyOf.description: Method used to calibrate the camera length constant and convert pixel distances in diffraction patterns to d-spacings or reciprocal lattice vectors.

anyOf.title: EDS Acquisition Mode
anyOf.description: Spatial acquisition sub-strategy for EDS measurements: stationary-beam point acquisition, line scan (beam stepped along a transect at defined intervals), or area map / spectrum image (beam rastered over a pixel grid). Specifies how the beam is positioned during data collection within the declared analytical mode. Record 'N/A' where the procedure has no EDS detector. 'Point' covers what the literature also calls spot or point-spectrum analysis. 'Map' and 'Spectrum image' are distinct acquisitions, not synonyms: a map may retain element intensities alone, whereas a spectrum image retains a full spectrum at every pixel and can be requantified afterwards — record which was acquired. Where more than one mode was used, join them with '; ' rather than looking for a combined member.

anyOf.title: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel
anyOf.description: EDS spectral acquisition live time per analysis point (point/line mode) or per pixel (spectrum image) in seconds. Also referred to as "EDS Acquisition Time" in EPMA and some SEM-EDS contexts, where the per-pixel distinction is less relevant. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

schema:name.const: EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel

anyOf.title: EDS Energy Range
anyOf.description: Energy range of EDS spectrum acquisition in keV. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Acquisition Mode
anyOf.description: Mode of EELS data acquisition. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Edges
anyOf.description: Ionization edge(s) acquired by EELS, specified by element symbol and edge label (e.g., Fe L2,3; O K). Provides the EELS-specific counterpart to the Analyte field: while Analyte lists elements, EELS Edges documents which ionization edges were used and their approximate energy loss positions. The edge list may be narrowed at analysis time. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Acquisition Time per Spectrum
anyOf.description: Exposure time per individual EELS spectrum (or per pixel for spectrum images) in seconds. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Energy Loss Range
anyOf.description: Energy loss range acquired, defined by onset energy and width in eV. The target range covers the registered analyte edges; the actual range acquired may differ. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: Specimen Thickness Determination Method
anyOf.description: Method used to estimate TEM foil thickness.

anyOf.title: EDS Calibration Standard(s)
anyOf.description: Reference material(s) used to validate EDS quantification or determine experimental k-factors or zeta-factors. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Energy Calibration
anyOf.description: Method and reference used to calibrate the EELS energy axis. Record 'N/A' where EELS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: Diffraction Calibration Reference
anyOf.description: Reference material or internal standard used to calibrate the electron diffraction camera constant (camera length × electron wavelength), enabling conversion of pixel distances to d-spacings.

anyOf.title: EDS Detection Limit
anyOf.description: Estimated detection limits by EDS under this procedure's conditions, one per reported concentration variable (one per analyte, these being the same set). Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EDS Counting Statistics / Accumulation Criterion
anyOf.description: Quality criterion used to determine when sufficient EDS signal has been accumulated for a given pixel or point, in lieu of or in addition to a fixed live time. Expressed as a target relative uncertainty on major-element peak counts achieved by accumulating successive scan frames (e.g., "1% counting statistics on major elements"; ">10% counting statistics"). Distinct from EDS Live Time per Point or Pixel, which records a fixed-duration setting. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).

anyOf.title: EELS Chemical State Determination Method
anyOf.description: Method used to determine the chemical or oxidation state of an element from the fine structure of its ionization edge (ELNES), together with the reference data or calibration the determination relies on. Name the method family and cite the calibration curve or reference spectra used. Record 'N/A' where no chemical-state determination is made.

This field documents the resulting percentage as a session QC metric. Record 'N/A' where EDS is not listed in Spectroscopic Detector(s).
